Author: Charlie1361
Name: XIVibration
Punchline: Controller vibration on every skill, following its sounds and hits.
Description: Every skill of every job makes your gamepad vibrate, following its sounds. After you log in, the plugin reads every skill's animation and sounds (the ones actually loaded, through Penumbra if you use mods). Each clear bump in a sound becomes a solid block at the sound's level with a short fade-out, and the sound's background doesn't vibrate: bass drives the strong motor, crisp sounds the weak one. Hits without a sound of their own come from the animation (hit reactions, effects on the target, MultiHit tables). The vibration goes through the game's own controller function, so it works with every controller the game supports. Animations that already vibrate on their own are left alone unless you choose to replace them. Skills are grouped by job, and every pattern can be edited on a DAW-style timeline that shows the sound; your edits are never overwritten.
